about.title: My story
story: My name is Arnau Palmer and I'm a technology integrator in Mallorca. I work on my own, close and direct: the person who answers you, designs the project and installs it is me.
I started with document management and intranets, and that's where I have real experience: internal portals, repositories and workflows for teams that were tired of losing documents along the way.

From there I'm expanding into networks, smart homes and AV. I won't tell you I've done it for twenty years, because it wouldn't be true: I'm training hard in each of those areas and I document the process on the blog and on social media, wins and mistakes included.
why: Every project starts by listening. I look at what you really need, how you work and how you live, and design a solution around that.

In intranets and document management I bring proven experience. In networks, smart homes and AV I work with open, consolidated standards (KNX, Ubiquiti, Sonos, Microsoft 365) while I specialise, and I price accordingly.
I work with total transparency: I tell you what I master, what I'm learning and when a project is beyond me. I'd rather lose a job than do it halfway.
After the install I'm still there: maintenance, monitoring and support so you're not left alone with the system.

faq.title: Your questions, answered
faq.subtitle: What you need to know before starting your project with me.

items.a: I work across Mallorca and, for larger projects, the rest of the Balearics (Menorca, Ibiza and Formentera).

items.q: Which services do you have most experience in?
items.a: In intranets and document management I have real, established experience. In networks, smart homes and AV I'm actively training: I work on real projects and document every step on the blog and social media.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance after installation?
items.a: Yes. I offer maintenance and remote monitoring to catch and fix issues before you notice them.
In most cases yes. I work with open standards (KNX, Ubiquiti, Sonos, Microsoft 365…) that integrate well with previous installations.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: Every project is unique. I do a no-obligation technical visit and give you a detailed, clear quote.
Yes, but it's the area I focus on least. If your project is mainly photovoltaic I'll say so clearly and, if needed, put you in touch with a specialist.
